# Chess artwork credits

The Jukebox's own code is MIT-licensed; these graphics have their own licenses.
All artwork is included in its source format as obtained from the sources below.
Color-inverted black Chessnut pieces are generated by the app using a CSS filter.

- **Cburnett** — Colin M. L. Burnett and subsequent Wikimedia Commons contributors. BSD 3-Clause; [license](licenses/cburnett-BSD-3-Clause.txt). The 12 files are the standard transparent pieces from [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:SVG_chess_pieces/Standard_transparent); these copies match the checksums on their individual Wikimedia file pages. Default set.
- **Chessnut** — Alexis Luengas. Apache 2.0; [license](../pieces/LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt); [source](https://github.com/LexLuengas/chessnut-pieces). The black side is displayed using a color inversion of the white artwork.
- **Celtic, Fantasy, Spatial** — Maurizio Monge. MIT; [license](licenses/monge-MIT.txt); [original source](https://github.com/maurimo/chess-art), files from [Lichess](https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/tree/master/public/piece).
- **Hera** — Toan Hoang. MIT; [license](licenses/hera-MIT.txt); [source](https://github.com/HollowLeaf1981/ChessPieces/tree/main/Hera).
- **Firi** — James Faure. [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); [source](https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/tree/master/public/piece/firi).
- **Papercut** — Nikolay Anzarov. [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); [source](https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/tree/master/public/piece/papercut).
- **Totoy** — Kosal Sen. [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); [source](https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/tree/master/public/piece/totoy).
- **Kiwen-suwi** — neverRare. [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); [source](https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/tree/master/public/piece/kiwen-suwi).
- **Kaneo** — Kadagaden. [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); [original project](https://github.com/Kadagaden/chess-pieces), files from [Chess_diagram_to_FEN](https://github.com/tsoj/Chess_diagram_to_FEN/tree/main/resources/pieces/chess/other/chess_kaneo).
- **RhosGFX** — RhosGFX. [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/); [source](https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/tree/master/public/piece/rhosgfx).
- **Livius** — Martin Sedlak. [Public-domain dedication](licenses/livius-public-domain.txt); [source](https://github.com/kmar/chess_svg_piece_sets/tree/main/livius).

The three solid-color boards use simple color pairs. The preview shows the position after 20...Rg6, Zukertort–Steinitz, New York 1886, game 1.
